newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Goldman boosts Medtronic.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Goldman boosts Medtronic.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs analyst Larry Keush said he raised his rating on Medtronic Inc to recommended from market outperformer and said the brokerage had put the stock on its priority list.
-- The analyst said he had made no changes in his earnings estimates, which remain $2.25 for fiscal 1997 and $2.70 per share for fiscal 1998. His target price was also left at $75.
-- Medtronic stock had gained 3-3/4 to 65-1/8 by mid-morning Wednesday.
